lemma comparable_bundle (P:Fin n→Menu S L) (hP:∀ j,Comparable l T (Tree.down j z) (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) (Tree.cost (f j) (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) (Tree.childAge j a) (wages (Tree.childWages j v))) (P j)):Comparable l T z (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) (V (fork n f) κ a (wages v)) (fuse P) := by
   intro k
   have hQ:= Eligible.products P injective_id hT (fun j=>Comparable.earns (hP j) le_rfl) le_rfl h
   obtain ⟨hz,hk,-⟩:= hQ k
   refine ⟨hz,hk,(RateLE.prod (S:=Finset.univ) hT (fun j _=> (hP j (k j)).2.2)).mono ?_⟩
   rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_mul]; change (∑ j,Tree.cost (f j) (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) (Tree.childAge j a) (wages (Tree.childWages j v))) - (∑ j:Fin n, ((P j).pick (k j)|>.cost))*(Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) ≤ _
   rw [← Atom.bundle_cost]; rfl

proof_context.conclusion: The fused menu's rate is the sum of the child rates minus the total picked degree times the parent age, which is the telescoping of `-j_u a_u` against `j_u a_v`.

lemma cost_loaded (hk:κ≤k) (m:ℕ):Comparable l T z κ Ω (loadedRaw U R z v (Tree.center z) m):=by
    have h₁(j:Cut R m):(loadedRaw U R z v (Tree.center z) m|>.pick j) = punctum (oneTag U R j.1 j.2) ((Menu.raw z v).charge R j.1 j.snd (Tree.center z)) (Tree.center z):=by
         exact congr_arg (fun p=> punctum (oneTag U R j.1 j.2) p (Tree.center z)) (funext fun q=> Eq.trans (one_mul (_:ℂ)) ((raw_charge z v R j.1 j.2 (Tree.center z) q).symm))
    intro j; change Cut R m at j; rw [h₁]
    refine ⟨⟨fun _=> t.topSeat,rfl⟩,Kept.sole l T (Tree.center z) κ, (hd.output j.1.val j.2).mono ?_⟩
    rw [punctum_cost]; exact sub_le_sub_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk j.1.val.cast_nonneg) _

proof_context.conclusion: Each loaded output of degree `j <= m` costs at most the base rate with `j * k` subtracted, so nonnegative degrees never raise the exponent.
